title: 祝英台近·春日客龟溪游废园
title_en: Zhu Ying Tai Jin: Visiting a Ruined Garden at Guixi in Spring
author: 吴文英

form.zh: 词，词牌《祝英台近》，双调七十七字
form.en: ci to the tune Zhu Ying Tai Jin, 77 characters in two stanzas

readings.zh: “斗草”是一种游戏，“斗”读 dòu，意思是比赛、争斗。
readings.en: Dòu cǎo is a game, so this character is read dòu, meaning to compete.

readings.zh: “因甚”就是“因为什么”，这里的“甚”读 shén，同“什么”的“什”。
readings.en: Yīn shén means for what reason. Here this character is read shén, as in the word for what.

glosses.zh: 幽香：淡淡的清香，这里指野花。
glosses.en: yōu xiāng: a faint, delicate scent; here, wild flowers.

glosses.zh: 巡古苑：在古老的园子里四处走走。苑，园林。
glosses.en: xún gǔ yuàn: wandering around an old garden. Yuàn means a park or garden.

glosses.zh: 翠微：青翠的山色，这里指山间。
glosses.en: cuì wēi: the soft green of the hills; here, hillside paths.

glosses.zh: 斗草：古代女孩子们春天玩的游戏，比谁采的花草多、谁的草茎更结实。
glosses.en: dòu cǎo: a spring game played by girls long ago, competing over who picked more plants or whose stem was stronger.

glosses.zh: 溪根：溪水边。
glosses.en: xī gēn: the edge of the stream.

glosses.zh: 小莲步：女子小小的脚印。古人常用“莲步”形容女子的脚步。
glosses.en: xiǎo lián bù: small footprints of girls. People of old called a woman's steps "lotus steps".

glosses.zh: 自怜：可怜自己。
glosses.en: zì lián: to pity oneself.

glosses.zh: 两鬓清霜：两边鬓角的头发都白了，像霜一样。
glosses.en: liǎng bìn qīng shuāng: the hair at both temples has turned white as frost.

glosses.zh: 寒食：寒食节，在清明节前一两天，这一天不生火，吃冷的食物，也是春游扫墓的时候。
glosses.en: hán shí: the Cold Food Festival, a day or two before Qingming. No fires were lit and people ate cold food. It was also a time for spring outings and visiting graves.

glosses.zh: 昼闲度：白天就这样闲闲地过去了。
glosses.en: zhòu xián dù: the day passes idly by.

glosses.zh: 因甚：为什么。
glosses.en: yīn shén: why, for what reason.

glosses.zh: 悭春：对春天很吝啬，舍不得给人好的春光。悭，小气。
glosses.en: qiān chūn: stingy with spring, unwilling to give fine spring days. Qiān means stingy.

glosses.zh: 轻阴：天上有薄薄的云，有点阴。
glosses.en: qīng yīn: a light cloud cover, slightly overcast.

glosses.zh: 长亭：古代路边供行人休息、送别的亭子。
glosses.en: cháng tíng: a roadside pavilion where travelers rested and friends said goodbye.

glosses.zh: 趁风絮：跟着随风飘的柳絮。趁，追随。
glosses.en: chèn fēng xù: following the willow fluff on the wind. Chèn means to go along with.

glosses.zh: 阑干：栏杆。
glosses.en: lán gān: a railing.

glosses.zh: 门径：门前的小路。
glosses.en: mén jìng: the path to the gate.

glosses.zh: 解：懂得，知道。
glosses.en: jiě: to know how to.

glosses.zh: 霎时：一会儿，很短的时间。
glosses.en: shà shí: for a moment.

glosses.zh: 凝伫：站着不动，出神地看。
glosses.en: níng zhù: to stand still, lost in thought.

translation.en: I go to gather faint, wild scents,

translation.zh: 在古老的废园里四处走走，
translation.en: And wander through the old garden,

translation.zh: 竹林清冷，小路通向青翠的山间。
translation.en: Past cold bamboo, along a path into the green hills.
By the stream, girls once played the grass game;

translation.zh: 沙地上还印着小小的脚印。
translation.en: The sand still shows their small footprints.

translation.zh: 可怜我两鬓已经白得像霜，
translation.en: I pity myself, my temples white as frost;

translation.zh: 又到了一年一度的寒食节，
translation.en: Another year's Cold Food Festival has come,

translation.zh: 我却又一次身在云山深处，远离家乡。
translation.en: And once again I am deep among clouds and hills, far from home.

translation.zh: 白天就这样闲闲地过去了。
为什么老天对春天这么吝啬，
translation.en: Why is Heaven so stingy with spring,

translation.zh: 天色刚有一点阴，就下起雨来？
translation.en: That a little cloud turns at once to rain?

translation.zh: 绿树浓密，遮暗了路边的长亭，
translation.en: Thick green shade darkens the roadside pavilion;

translation.zh: 我回家的梦，跟着风中的柳絮飘走了。
translation.en: My dream of going home drifts off with the willow fluff on the wind.

translation.zh: 栏杆上的花影好像懂得感情，
translation.en: The flower shadows on the railing seem to have feelings,

translation.zh: 门前小路上的黄莺也在啼叫，
translation.en: And so do the orioles singing by the gate path;

translation.zh: 它们懂得把我留住，让我站着出神一会儿。
translation.en: They know how to hold me here, standing still a while, lost in thought.

background.zh: 龟溪在今天浙江德清一带。题目说，这是春天词人客居龟溪时，去游一座荒废的园子写的。正赶上寒食节，他一个人在外地，看到园中景物，想到自己年纪渐老、漂泊不定，写下了这首词。具体是哪一年写的，已经无法确定。
background.en: Guixi is in today's Deqing area of Zhejiang. The title says Wu Wenying wrote this in spring while staying at Guixi as a guest, on a visit to a ruined garden. It was the Cold Food Festival, and he was alone far from home. The garden's scenes made him think of growing old and of his drifting life, so he wrote this lyric. The exact year is not known.

author_note.zh: 吴文英（约1200—约1260），号梦窗，四明（今浙江宁波）人。他一生没有做官，长年在苏州、杭州一带给官员做门客，常常客居他乡。他的词用字讲究，画面细密，常把眼前景物和往事、梦境交织在一起，读起来有一种朦胧的美。
author_note.en: Wu Wenying (about 1200 – about 1260), known by his pen name Mengchuang, came from Siming, today's Ningbo in Zhejiang. He never held office and spent many years as a guest adviser to officials around Suzhou and Hangzhou, often living away from home. His lyrics choose words with great care and paint fine, detailed pictures. He often weaves the scene before him together with the past and with dreams, which gives his work a hazy beauty.

appreciation.zh: 上片写游园。词人采野花，走过古园，竹林清冷，小路伸进山里。溪边沙地上还留着女孩子玩斗草时的小脚印，可见这里曾经很热闹，如今却只剩他一个人。他摸摸两鬓，已经白了；又是一个寒食节，他却还在深山里做客。下片写天气和心情。白天闲闲地过去，老天偏偏小气，天一阴就下雨。绿荫遮住长亭，想回家的梦只能跟着柳絮飘走。最后，花影和莺声好像懂他的心，把他留住，让他在原地站了好一会儿。整首词淡淡的，却透着一种说不出的孤单和思乡之情。
appreciation.en: The first stanza is the walk through the garden. He picks wild flowers, passes through the old garden, by cold bamboo, along a path into the hills. In the sand by the stream there are still small footprints from girls playing the grass game. This place was once lively, but now only he is here. He touches his temples and finds them white. Another Cold Food Festival has come, and he is still a guest deep in the hills. The second stanza is about weather and mood. The day passes idly, and Heaven is stingy: a few clouds and it rains. Green shade hides the pavilion, and his dream of home can only drift away with the willow fluff. At last the flower shadows and the orioles seem to understand him, holding him still for a long moment. The whole lyric is quiet and light, yet full of a loneliness and homesickness that is hard to put into words.
